Title: Explainer: Eskerland's chemical exports
Source: Freight & Ledger
Published: 2025-01-10
Type: explainer
Event: background
Country: Eskerland; Fjordheim
Sector: chemicals
Tier: 2

Eskerland ships most of its chemicals through two ports, Eskhaven and a smaller terminal near Fjordvik.

Fjordvik has spare quay space but limited tank storage.
